scope.scope_reason: 12 LABEL_COUNTEREXAMPLE + 2 STRUCTURAL_LABEL_CONFLICT + 15 PUBLISHED_WITNESS_NOT_REPRODUCED + 1 nondeterministic UNVERIFIED case from Syam audit; not the 495-case unsupported backlog.
scope.hardware_scope: Native ARM64 only; fresh-process repetitions, no paid API calls.

scientific_limits: Documented disposition is not historical runtime provenance or universal equivalence proof.
No labels, source programs, archived responses, scores, tolerances or paper results are changed.

Four selected witnesses are dtype-only comparisons. Three dtype-changing cases also have numeric differences on saved seed 123; the fourth has a numeric difference on preflight-accepted stored metadata. Metadata does not prove actual historical runtime use.
A shared-input counterexample establishes current behavior on that input, not that a fixed historical-input label was computed incorrectly.

Unresolved historical inputs/toolchain, unsafe metadata, verifier-version differences and precision behavior remain explicit; no corrected-label table or claim of unchanged conclusions under relabeling is adopted.

diagnostic_control.patch: Only in a separate diagnostic copy, change the affected iterator_types from [parallel,reduction] to [reduction,parallel].

cases.diagnosis: Output map changes d0 to d1, but iterator types remain [parallel,reduction]. Different d0 iterations target the same d1 output accumulator. The saved source is accepted by both verifiers; repeated execution is not stable. A separate iterator-only diagnostic repair is stable and matches a column-wise NumPy reference.
cases.action: Quarantine from new deterministic semantic-label claims; preserve the original program and recorded DIVERGE label.

cases.diagnosis: The divisor changes from 9 to 1. Independently generated shared arguments can differ, exposing a nonzero mean absolute difference multiplied by nine. Stored metadata has equal arguments and yields zero in both versions.
cases.action: Retain the current-suite counterexample and the archived EQUIV observation as different input scopes; do not claim recovery of actual historical inputs.

cases.diagnosis: The only source edit changes the NaN-count divisor from 12 to 1. With finite inputs, cmpf une(x,x) is false, so the numerator is zero and this output is unchanged. All shared-input trials agree. Independently embedded inputs differ and reproduce both stored outputs, including their differing final sums; this is evidence for a different-input historical hypothesis, not a semantic divergence.
cases.action: Preserve the original observation; do not use different-input output replay as a semantic divergence witness. Do not assert universal equivalence.

cases.diagnosis: The mutation fuses compare and cast into a multi-output linalg.generic. The signed seed-0 input exposes an exact floating-point difference in the returned sum; stored metadata replay agrees. The precise compiler pass causing the low-bit difference has not been isolated.
cases.action: Retain as an exact current-suite difference, with compiler-layout sensitivity unresolved; do not add an output tolerance.

cases.diagnosis: All five saved shared-input trials agree. Ten-repeat replay agrees. Independently embedded original/mutated inputs differ and reproduce both stored historical outputs. This explains those outputs under a concrete hypothesis, not a recovered actual-runtime trace.
cases.action: Preserve the original observation; do not use different-input output replay as a semantic divergence witness. Do not assert universal equivalence.

cases.diagnosis: The fill seed changes from i1 true to f32 zero for an i1 output. LLVM19 and IREE 2024 accept the source; the packaged IREE 3.12 backend verifier rejects the mismatched fill type. Legacy execution also changes the boolean reduction on saved seed 123.
cases.action: Treat as a version-dependent verification/error-test case, not an unconditional well-defined semantic counterexample. Preserve the archived label.

cases.diagnosis: The equality-count divisor changes from 9 to 8. With all-one equal arguments (saved seed 123), the fraction changes from 1 to 1.125. Archived outputs have zero equality count, where either divisor gives zero. Safe metadata replay differs, showing that metadata is not sufficient to prove the historical runtime.
cases.action: Document a genuine current-input numeric difference; do not silently overwrite the fixed historical label or claim the metadata was executed.

cases.diagnosis: The mutation changes returned scalar f32 computations to f64. Four saved trials are numerically equal but dtype-different; seed 123 also has a genuine numeric precision difference.
cases.action: Separate dtype-only flags from numeric divergence. Do not interpret every typed-exact failure as a paper-style value-comparison failure.

cases.diagnosis: The mutation changes returned f32 scalar computations to f64. Four saved trials differ only in dtype; seed 123 also differs numerically.
cases.action: Retain both comparison results and preserve the original label; no tolerance or dtype-coercion change is applied to the validator.

cases.diagnosis: A vector matmul/dot is rewritten as multiply followed by sum. Seed 42 exposes a low-bit result difference; safe metadata replay agrees. Arithmetic grouping/lowering changes are implicated, not a proven defect in a particular compiler pass.
cases.action: Retain the exact current-suite difference and document input/precision sensitivity; original runtime provenance remains unproven.

cases.diagnosis: The returned row output changes from f32 to f64. All five saved generated trials are numerically equal and differ only in dtype. Expanding the review to preflight-accepted stored metadata also exposes a real numeric precision difference. That metadata is not proven to be the actual historical input.
cases.action: Separate the dtype-only saved trials from the additional numeric witness; do not dismiss the pair or silently adopt a corrected historical label.

cases.diagnosis: Variance calculations using f64 accumulation are rewritten to f32 paths. Seeds 1 and 2026 expose low-bit differences; safe metadata replay agrees.
cases.action: Document precision-dependent behavior rather than rounding it away or treating mathematical equivalence as machine equality.

cases.diagnosis: The fraction/one-minus-fraction output changes from f32 to f64. Four saved trials are numerically equal; seed 123 also differs numerically.
cases.action: Report contract and precision effects separately; preserve historical scoring.

cases.diagnosis: pow(x,2) is rewritten as x*x in a variance computation. Seeds 42 and 123 expose low-bit output differences; safe metadata replay agrees. The lowering-level cause is not fully isolated.
cases.action: Retain exact differences and the limitation on backend-independent conclusions.
